content.text:
My review is complete. Findings:

- **§1(a) (p0004)** engages Contractor "on a task by task basis" under individual Statements of Work — an inherently non-exclusive, work-order structure with no minimum commitment or requirements obligation.
- The only three "exclusive" hits are unrelated to exclusive dealing: **p0020** (Contractor's IP remains its "sole and exclusive property"), **p0021** (a *non-exclusive* perpetual license granted **to us** — benefits Clear Capital), and **p0051** (entire-agreement/"complete and exclusive agreement" boilerplate).
- No "sole supplier," "sole and exclusive provider," "all of its requirements," or "shall not procure … from any third party" language anywhere. The only restrictive covenant is **§13 (p0047)**, a mutual non-solicitation of employees — not a purchasing restriction, and covered by a different rule.

This meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services"), and Contractor agrees to furnish the Services on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Clear Capital, which is the playbook's preferred position. Section 1(a) retains RadialSpark "on a task by task basis" under separately negotiated Statements of Work, with no minimum volume, requirements commitment, or covenant restricting Clear Capital from procuring comparable consulting services from third parties; Section 2 (p0011) likewise sets an open term terminable under Paragraph 6 without any exclusive-dealing period. The three instances of "exclusive" in the document are not exclusive-dealing provisions: p0020 confirms Contractor's pre-existing IP remains its "sole and exclusive property" (an ownership allocation), p0021 grants Clear Capital a "royalty-free, non-exclusive perpetual license" (a grant that benefits us and expressly non-exclusive), and p0051 is entire-agreement boilerplate ("complete and exclusive agreement"). The only restrictive covenant is Section 13 (p0047), a mutual one-year non-solicitation of employees, which restricts hiring rather than purchasing and does not limit our supplier freedom; it is also reciprocal and falls under a separate rule. No redline is required.
